name: AI in Security Operations
blurb: Defending with AI: machine-speed investigation, human supervision models, automation bias, kill-switch protocols, and securing the SOC's own AI.

items.name: Government guidance for AI in cyber defense
items.note: CISA's AI hub collects the agency's roadmap, use cases, and secure-adoption guidance for defensive AI.

items.name: A documented AI SOC platform
items.note: Microsoft's Security Copilot documentation - a primary-source record of what shipped AI security operations tooling actually does and how supervision is designed.

items.name: When the defense is also a target
items.note: Lab threat reporting documents attacks on and through AI systems - the SOC's own AI is part of the attack surface.
